title: Impact runbook and scenario index for embedding rerank evals
creator: Lina Chen
description:
Goal: Build a reproducible, prioritized "scenario index" that maps configuration and model deltas (quantization profiles, batching targets, model variants) to a small set of targeted offline evaluations and weighted synthetic probes. This enables deterministic impact estimates (delta recall/precision, top-K churn, cohort drift) for each proposed config/model change before rollout.

Scope and deliverables:
- Scenario index: canonical catalog of ~30 scenarios (slicing by query intent, document length, corpus freshness, tail cohorts) with test inputs, expected metrics, and severity multipliers.
- Weighted synthetic probes: parameterized generators to stress cases (near-duplicates, paraphrase attacks, prompt truncation) with tunable weight vectors to reflect real-traffic distributions.
- Delta scorer: single-number impact score that combines metric deltas (recall@k, precision@k, nDCG, embedding cosine shifts) using scenario severity and sample weights.
- Triggering integration: wire index to config-change webhook so PRs that change model/config emit an automated evaluation plan and run on shadow pipeline.
- Runbook & rollback playbook: clear thresholds for when to block rollout, require manual review, or auto-rollback plus templated Slack and incident channels.

Design choices and trade-offs considered:
- Sampling fidelity vs. speed: will maintain a small fast-path subset for CI + full run for pre-prod nightly.
- Metric aggregation: chose weighted linear combination (delta-score) to keep interpretation simple for SRE/PMs, with optional per-metric breakdown for auditors.
- Scenario churn: scenarios are versioned; changes to scenario definitions require a scenario-migration note and a one-off audit run to rebaseline historical deltas.

Integration points and artifacts:
- Confluence spec: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Embed+Rerank+Scenario+Index (draft)
- Design doc: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1X-embed-rerank-scenarios
- GitHub prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/embed-evals/tree/feature/scenario-index
- Dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/embed-eval-delta (mockup)

Acceptance criteria:
- Automated plan generated for any config/model change PR touching serving/runtime or reranker config, including list of scenarios and estimated run time.
- Delta scorer implemented and validated on 3 historical config changes (must surface known regressions).
- Alerting thresholds configured: delta-score > 0.12 -> tag for PM review, >0.20 -> block rollout and page on-call.
- Runbook published and dry-run executed during next canary roll.

Risks and mitigation:
- False positives from synthetic probes: mitigate by weighting probes low by default and requiring cross-check on real replay samples.
- Compute cost for full runs: implement two-tier run (fast CI subset + scheduled full pre-prod) and add adaptive sample sizing.

Roadmap milestones:
- Week 1 (this cycle): finalize scenario taxonomy, implement fast-path probes.
- Week 2: integrate webhook + CI runner, implement delta scorer prototype.
- Week 3: run retrospective on 3 past model changes, tune weights and thresholds.
- Week 4: publish runbook and wire alerting to Console.
